name: Adrian D. Cleveland
office: Compton Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2 (Unexpired term ending December 8, 2028)

items.text: Adrian D. Cleveland is a plant manager with the Compton Unified School District. In a board application, Cleveland wrote of over 30 years of leadership experience in personnel supervision, fiscal oversight, regulatory compliance, and labor-management engagement. He is a Compton College graduate and supports student success, workforce alignment, and institutional stability.
